metadata.sparse_protocol: Rank two; cyclic five diagonals; exact dyadic values; 1 worker; owned output; prepared operands except auto construction. Kernix Matrix finite checks vs peer IEEE policies; payload excludes capacity, metadata and allocator overhead. CSR indices usize in Kernix/faer and actual recorded SciPy width. SpGEMM heap merge vs SciPy column accumulator; fill-in depends on pattern. Construction: Kernix clones a Vec then validates/scans/compresses; SciPy borrows dense input and allocates CSR output; NumPy/dense Kernix copy only. Construction compares API trade-offs, not identical algorithms. No universal sparse speed or density threshold claim.
metadata.rank_modification_protocol: Kernix/nalgebra: prepared base factor, owned modified factor; refactor: same Kernix version, full factorization of preformed modified matrix; base setup and matrix formation excluded
metadata.minimum_norm_algorithm: pivoted QR plus scaled implicit RZ
